title: EOS Classification
description: Embedded reference value object assigning one controlled classification to its parent. Catalog existence, meaning, and origin are not validated by this structural contract.

classificationId.description: Identifier of a future Classification Catalog Entry, not of this embedded instance.

sourceLinks.description: Structurally optional evidence using the common EOS SourceLink contract. External classifications require provenance semantically; catalog-aware enforcement is deferred to Phase 0.2B.2.
